production.scope: read-only bounded indexed metadata/timing selection, no prompts or chat bodies
production.method: Live SQLite URI mode=ro, bounded indexed metadata/timing queries for five specified turn IDs and source-event primary keys; no production writes or new requests
limitations: Selected natural turns, not a random latency distribution or proven all explicit mentions
No message, prompt, reasoning, credentials, tool arguments or tool results included
Source occurred_at can predate ingestion; it is not used as processing latency origin
Trace may be incomplete; missing delivery in retained trace is not proof of platform failure
Nested phase durations must not be added to parent logical durations; sums are not a proven exclusive critical path
Cache usage is per recorded upstream invocation, not inferred from local fingerprints

offline_provider_probe.scope: in-process real Executor and Chat adapter with HTTPX MockTransport; no socket, DB, production or paid model

offline_social_probe.limitation: No ToolKernel/Work activation or real HTTP/platform; one sample timing not benchmark; fixture account scope; original inbound/Presence explicitly bound

offline_media_probe.scope: real ApplicationContainer/Processor/SQLite/MediaResolver/AttachmentInputService/ConversationMediaService/EmojiCollector; fake DNS and HTTPX MockTransport; fake model; no NoneBot socket, real gateway, network or delivery
limitations: Proves three independent byte fetches on this configured successful cold-cache fixture only.
Does not prove all media repeat three times, production frequency, elapsed-time saving, image-decode counts, permission/cancellation equivalence, or a completed optimization.
